gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
This job calls ___ someone with patience.
gaps.explanation: call for = require, demand (circumstances call for action).

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ off until Thursday.
gaps.explanation: 'Put off' = postpone to a later time.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
She was brought ___ by her grandparents.
gaps.explanation: bring up a child = raise, educate them.

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.
